Glaciological_Role: Controls lateral and longitudinal back-stress on upstream grounded tributary glaciers. 1.0 = fully buttressed; 0.0 = complete ice-shelf collapse (Larsen B state).
Observational_Calibration_Anchor: Derived from historical ERS/Envisat/Sentinel-1 shelf collapse timing (2002 Larsen B event in Ipp-J; 1995 Larsen A event).
Future_Projection_Mechanism: Driven by surface meltwater hydrofracture thresholds (Trusel et al. 2015) under SSP scenarios.

Glaciological_Role: Quantifies the physical areal extent of floating ice shelves (Larsen C, George VI, Wilkins, Bach). Modulates basal melt volume and calving loss.
Observational_Calibration_Anchor: Historical MODIS / Landsat / Sentinel-1 mosaic shelf extent masks (1995–2024).
Future_Projection_Mechanism: ISMIP6 ice shelf collapse masks and structural front retreat thresholds.

Glaciological_Role: Tracks ungrounding of marine-based ice sheet along retrograde bedrock troughs. Determines change in grounded area A_grounded(t).
Observational_Calibration_Anchor: MEaSUREs DInSAR grounding line vector series (1992, 1996, 2000, 2011, 2016).
Future_Projection_Mechanism: Schoof (2007) / Pattyn (2017) boundary flux formula integrated along 500 m BedMachine V4.1 bed profiles.

Glaciological_Role: Represents the compressive horizontal stress transmitted across shear margins into tributary outlet glacier grounding zones.
Mathematical_Formulation_in_Phase5: sigma_xx = 0.5 * rho_ice * g * H * (1 - rho_ice/rho_w) - tau_lateral * W_fjord
Observational_Calibration_Anchor: Calibrated from ITS_LIVE strain rate tensors (1996–2024) across Crane and Flask glaciers.
Future_Projection_Mechanism: Coupled to ice shelf thinning and structural embayment geometry.

Glaciological_Role: Controls basal melting at sub-ice shelf grounding lines, driving grounding zone thinning and unpinning in Palmer Land West (Hp-I).
Observational_Calibration_Anchor: Schmidtko et al. (2014) continental shelf hydrographic observations and BedMachine cavity geometry.
Future_Projection_Mechanism: CMIP6 AOGCM ocean component projections (NorESM1-M, CESM2, UKESM1-0-LL) via ISMIP6 ocean files.

Physical_State_Name: Contemporaneous Annual Surface Mass Balance Forcing
Glaciological_Role: Replaces lag-1 SMB with in-year contemporaneous surface accumulation and melt, capturing intense snowfall surges (e.g. 2016 Palmer Land event).
Mathematical_Formulation_in_Phase5: V_grounded(t) = V_grounded(t-1) + SMB_contemp(t) / rho_ice - D(t) / rho_ice
Future_Projection_Mechanism: Downscaled CMIP6 ESM projections across SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, and SSP5-8.5.

Physical_State_Name: Retrograde Bed Slope & Pinning Point Geometry
Physical_Units: m (bed elevation relative to geoid) & m/km (slope db/dx)
Glaciological_Role: Determines Marine Ice Sheet Instability (MISI) vulnerability. Deep inland-sloping bedrock causes self-sustaining grounding line retreat.
Mathematical_Formulation_in_Phase5: h_GL(x) = S(x) - B(x); db/dx < 0 triggers unstable grounding line retreat when unpinned
Observational_Calibration_Anchor: Phase 2.6 verified 500 m BedMachine V4.1 (IceBoost ML) bed topography.
Future_Projection_Mechanism: Static geometric constraint governing dynamic grounding line retreat trajectories.
